decisions.reason: The instruction concerns rendering the word “Creativity” in the bottle-and-cloud design. The stamped-meat design already specifies the complete slogan and has a separate typography treatment; no change to it is entailed.
The grill illustration shares the slogan text but uses an independent smoke rendering. The source does not direct a change to that design or establish that its word rendering is affected.
The Riverton sky design does not contain the affected Creativity slogan, so its text bubble, text span, and place name remain unchanged.
A typography correction within one illustration does not change the hand-drawn, non-AI production-method requirement.
